name: phootime
description: Phootime turns your photos into canvas prints and framed wall art, and sells ready-made artworks from shop.phootime.com (Taiwan).

interface.longDescription:
Phootime (shop.phootime.com) is a Taiwan-based maker of canvas prints and framed wall art.

With Phootime in ChatGPT you can:
- Turn your own photos into wall art: canvas prints, metal frame prints, wood frames, silk canvas, magnetic canvas, Frame Neo acrylic frames and giclée prints. Phootime checks which sizes your photo's resolution supports, shows a preview of the printed area and quotes the price.
- Upload original, full-resolution photos right in the chat. Photos attached to ChatGPT are downsized, which limits how large they can be printed.
- Combine several photos into one collage in Phootime's online editor, or order each photo as its own print.
- Browse and buy ready-made artworks by Phootime artists.

When you're ready, Phootime creates a cart link. You enter your shipping details and pay on shop.phootime.com; nothing is charged inside ChatGPT. Prices are in New Taiwan dollars and include tax; shipping fees are shown at checkout.
defaultPrompt: Turn my photo into a canvas print and show me the sizes and prices
Find ocean landscape artworks for my living room
Make one collage from a few of my photos

zh-TW.subtitle: 把照片印成牆上的畫
zh-TW.description:
Phootime（shop.phootime.com）是台灣的無框畫與裱框畫印製網站。

在 ChatGPT 裡可以：
- 把自己的照片做成畫：畫布無框畫、金屬鋁框畫、木框畫、細絹無框畫、磁吸霧柔無框畫、霓彩懸浮相框、微噴單張輸出。Phootime 會檢查照片解析度夠印哪些尺寸、顯示印製範圍預覽並報價。
- 直接在對話裡上傳原始照片。ChatGPT 會把附加的照片縮小，影響能印的尺寸。
- 把多張照片做成一幅拼貼（在 Phootime 網站編輯器排版），或每張各做一幅。
- 瀏覽並選購 Phootime 創作者的線上作品。

選好之後，Phootime 會建立購物車連結；收件資料與付款都在 shop.phootime.com 完成，ChatGPT 裡不會收費。價格為新台幣含稅，運費於結帳頁顯示。

positive.description: Search ready-made artworks with a price limit
positive.prompt: Find some ocean landscape artworks I can buy as canvas prints for under NT$3,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Phootime's artwork card with up to 10 artworks: the official artwork image, title, artist, orientation, starting price in TWD and a button that opens each artwork page on shop.phootime.com.

positive.description: Create a cart link for an artwork
positive.prompt: Search Phootime for a cat artwork, then create a cart link for a 30x45 cm canvas print of the first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Phootime's cart card with the artwork thumbnail, size, price and a button that opens shop.phootime.com with the item in the cart. No payment happens in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Check and quote an attached photo
positive.prompt: How big can I print this photo as a canvas print? Please quote a 40x60 cm canvas.
positive.expected_behavior: prepare_photo shows a photo card with the pixel size and the print sizes the resolution supports. Because ChatGPT downsizes attachments, the card also offers a button to upload the original photo. quote_custom_product shows a quote card with the price, a preview of the printed area, the production lead time and the free-shipping status.

positive.description: Upload original photos in the chat
positive.prompt: I want to print my own photo really large. Let me upload the original file.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows an upload box. After an image file is chosen, it is uploaded to Phootime, the card shows its resolution and printable sizes, and a message with the photo_ref is posted to the chat so the assistant can continue with a quote. If several photos are chosen at once, the card asks whether to make one collage or a separate print of each.

positive.description: Browse products for your own photo and get a quote
positive.prompt: What can Phootime make from my own photo, and how much is a 30x30 cm metal frame print?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Phootime's product card with each product that can be made from your own photo: the official product photo, starting price in TWD, sizes and options. Then shows a quote card for the 30x30 cm metal frame print with the price and production lead time.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Taipei tomorrow?
Write a short poem about the ocean.

review.commerce_description: Phootime sells physical wall art (canvas prints, framed prints and other photo products). The app quotes prices and creates a cart link; the shopper enters shipping details and pays on shop.phootime.com. No payment, card data or shipping address is collected inside ChatGPT.
